```yaml
name: Bump Progressive Rollout Version Command

on:
  repository_dispatch:
    types: [bump-progressive-rollout-version-command]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  bump-progressive-rollout-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install airbyte-ci
        run: |
          pip install airbyte-ci

      - name: Get PR details
        id: pr_details
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.client_payload.pull_request.number }}
          echo "pr_number=$PR_NUMBER" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "pr_author=${{ github.event.client_payload.pull_request.user.login }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "pr_head_ref=${{ github.event.client_payload.pull_request.head.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Bump version with RC suffix
        run: |
          airbyte-ci connectors --modified bump-version --rc
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add .
          git diff --staged --quiet || git commit -m "chore: bump connector versions for progressive rollout"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ steps.pr_details.outputs.pr_head_ref }}

      - name: Comment on PR
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GH_PAT_APPROVINGTON_OCTAVIA }}
          script: |
            const prNumber = context.payload.client_payload.pull_request.number;
            const senderLogin = context.payload.client_payload.sender.login;
            const comment = `
            ## Progressive Rollout Version Bump
            
            Connector versions have been bumped with an RC suffix for progressive rollout.
            
            **Next Steps:**
            1. Verify the version bumps in the PR changes.
            2. Ensure \`enableProgressiveRollout: true\` is set in \`metadata.yaml\` for the affected connectors.
            3. Merge this PR to trigger the progressive rollout process.
            
            > Note: This command was triggered by \`${senderLogin}\`.
            `;
            
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: prNumber,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: comment
            });
```
